layers.description: Remove whole files owned by initial/app-updates.
Retain the Molly updater and update preferences on the updated Signal application structure.
Resolve dynamic colors, themes and moved UI APIs while retaining Molly appearance behavior.
Remove whole files owned by initial/backup-and-restore.
Resolve backup and restore API changes while retaining Molly backup preferences and serialization behavior.
Retain the Molly map implementation and compatibility layer in the upgraded tree.
Resolve modify/delete conflicts for modules Molly removes and remove new upstream files added beneath those excluded modules.
Remove whole files owned by initial/networking-and-proxies.
Carry Molly SOCKS, Tor, DNS and transport choices through the updated Signal networking interfaces and NetCipher integration.
Remove whole files owned by initial/notifications-and-unifiedpush.
Retain MollySocket, UnifiedPush and push-selection behavior while resolving notification and delivery API changes.
Remove whole files owned by initial/payments-and-donations.
Keep MobileCoin and Google billing excluded while adapting the remaining donation and migration code.
Retain Molly privacy policies for calls, unknown contacts and logging in the updated upstream code.
Remove whole files owned by initial/registration-and-linking.
Adapt Molly registration and Android linked-device policies to the new Signal registration architecture.
Remove whole files owned by initial/resources-and-branding.
Resolve shared resource conflicts and relocated resources, retaining the port source's Molly branding and translations.
Remove whole files owned by initial/security-and-locking.
Integrate encrypted preferences, secret handling and lock-aware application behavior with the updated Signal classes.
Remove whole files owned by initial/integration.
Resolve shared application, account, service and core integration files whose APIs or feature boundaries changed upstream.
Remove whole files owned by initial/build-and-release.
Integrate the new Signal build layout and toolchain with Molly dependency, native-fork and release policies.
Restore the Molly preference import in ported megaphones

Use the typed SDK DSL for Molly's NetCipher module

AGP 9.4 rejects the numeric SDK catalog string passed to compileSdkVersion.
Match Signal's compileSdk release DSL while retaining the pinned SDK version
and strict dependency verification.
Remove whole files owned by followups/integration-and-regression-tests.

Adapt Molly integrations and tests to Signal 8.33.2

Update linked-device provisioning and FCM cleanup for the current service APIs while preserving proxy configuration, error types, user-selected delivery and retry credentials. Move remaining event producers and lifecycle-bound subscribers to Signal's event bus.

Repair lock-aware receivers, encrypted backup preference imports, retained donation completion, dynamic theme resources and moved branding references. Keep Molly's excluded profile-badge and payment-wallet features excluded, and adapt inherited test fixtures accordingly.

Add transport and cleanup regressions for MollySocket, UnifiedPush and FCM.
Fix CDN test configuration for Molly network transport
Restore the linked-device reminder after successful primary-device multi-device re-registration; explicitly mark re-registration intents.
Restore migrated Molly settings from preference frames before later KeyValue frames, drain pending store writes before restore, and test restore precedence.
Restore immediate donation badge acknowledgement and the eligible monthly sustainer link; remove unsupported profile-display copy and the completed-donation loading spinner.
Clean up legacy Molly backup alerts by checking their untagged notification ID and backup channel, while keeping Signal IDs for new alerts.
Restore non-self recipient badge lists while keeping badge interactions disabled.
Restore system information behavior while the application is locked.
Restore copyright notices in remaining resource files.
Restore Molly dynamic-color extended palette selection.
Preserve Molly blocked-network priority, including a blocked VPN with an unvalidated underlying network.
Restore the non-interactive featured badge on non-self recipient avatars.
Remove the redundant secure preference write when recording the app version.
Restore Molly formatting for Giphy client construction without changing proxy behavior.
Restore Molly always-relay preference accessor while preserving proxy settings.
Restore Molly unfiltered logcat collection.
Retain Molly message processor and reactions theme imports.
Retain Molly activity, conversation, place picker and push socket imports.
Retain Molly screen-lock import punctuation and mechanical-merge reaction overlay import order.
Retain Molly media composer, attachment and preference imports.
Keep direct backup alert cancellation expressions alongside legacy alert cleanup.
Remove unreachable pre-27 bottom-sheet selectors; retain API 27 color definitions.
Retain the longer one-line registration signature and omit added prose; the debug timing log loses the shared-contacts duration.

Restore the Molly unavailable-contact message, dropping the prior-use distinction; restore Molly imports and the currently unused legacy PlainTextSharedPrefsDataStore API, and remove one unused import.

Restore numerous unused navigation imports, a network import and telecom comment; restore a currently uncalled ShareActivity container override that could return the wrong host container for a future sheet path.

Restore an uncalled camera count component and four legacy settings files; the count remains undisplayed and the help view model can wipe logs if invoked. The checked first-launch preference write throws on failure.
Restore namespace-equivalent Signal XML formatting.
Generate pinned locale translations and move locale please_wait entries to strings2.
